title: Sitting quietly alone
idea: Pascal argued that much human restlessness comes from being unable to sit quietly alone. We chase distraction to avoid ourselves.
apply: Sit for ten minutes with no phone, book, or music. Notice the urge to escape, and stay.
who: Mia, who cannot wait for a coffee without her phone.

items.x: A quiet evening: phone and TV

scenes.nar: Mia fills every free minute. Waiting for coffee, the elevator, even a quiet evening, all with a screen.

scenes.cap: minutes of true quiet in her day
scenes.sub: Pascal saw this restlessness in the 1600s.
scenes.nar: She has zero minutes of true quiet in her day. Pascal noticed this restlessness in the seventeenth century.

items.x: Ten minutes, phone in another room

scenes.nar: So she tries it. Ten minutes, phone in another room, no book. She sits, and notices the urge to escape.
The first day is restless. By the end of week one she is calmer, and by week two, ideas begin to show up in the quiet.
